爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD026 竹内由纪Takeuchi Yuki-甜蜜测试
看她系裙襬转圈，我指指脸颊开手臂：“先过来让我抱抱亲亲，检验可爱度！”
她蹦跳着扑来，软糯的吻像棉花糖，草莓味唇膏混着笑声：“合格了吗？”
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD026 Takeuchi Yuki-Sweet Test
Watching her twirl around while tying her skirt, I pointed to my cheek and opened my arms: "Come here and let me hug and kiss you, to test your cuteness!"
She bounced over, her soft kiss like cotton candy, strawberry-flavored lipstick mixed with laughter: "Did I pass?"
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
